A CULINARY SANCTUARY

ABOUT THE GRAND MAHARAJA Leicester

Vegetarian dining at The Grand Maharaja is an art form. Slow-simmered daals, rich aromatic paneer gravies, hand-stretched tandoori breads, and stone-ground spices roasted in-house daily honour timeless royal culinary recipes passed down through generations of master chefs.

The Imperial Dining Hall

From our dedicated Jain & Swaminarayan kitchen sanctum prepared strictly with separate utensils and without root vegetables, to our private 200-guest banqueting suite and welcoming hearth lounge, we invite you to gather, feast, and celebrate in an atmosphere of enduring warmth and regal hospitality.


Time-Honoured Recipes

Honouring Ancient Recipes & Sacred Spices

Vegetarian dining at The Grand Maharaja is an art form. Our master chefs prepare each sauce, slow-simmered daal, and aromatic curry from scratch daily, honoring royal culinary traditions passed down through generations of culinary masters.

From the velvety richness of Shahi Paneer and rich Kaju curries to traditional Gujarati Thali delicacies, sizzling tandoor naans, and vibrant street chaats, our kitchen celebrates the richness of Indian regional cooking with modern luxury refinement.

  • ✦

    Pure Ingredients & In-House Whole Spices

    We source whole spices, roast them gently, and stone-grind them in-house daily for unmatched aroma and royal depth.

  • ✦

    Freshly Baked Artisanal Tandoor Naans & Rotis

    Hand-stretched dough baked to perfection in blazing clay ovens, brushed with aromatic desi ghee.

Spiritual & Dietary Care

Dedicated Jain & Swaminarayan Sanctum

We understand the sacred sanctity of pure dietary discipline. For our Jain and Swaminarayan guests, we provide an extensive dedicated menu prepared without onions, garlic, or root vegetables, honoring age-old spiritual principles with culinary excellence.

Our kitchen observes meticulous separation, ensuring that your meals are cooked with separate cookware and utensils, giving our guests complete trust and reassurance.

  • ✦

    Strict Allium-Free & Root-Free Specialization

    Prepared strictly without onion, garlic, potatoes, or root vegetables, celebrated for rich sattvic taste.

  • ✦

    Dedicated Cookware & Separate Prep Stations

    Zero cross-contamination protocols giving your family absolute dining peace of mind.

Leicester’s Premier Banquet Suite

Grand Celebrations Fit for Royalty

Whether you are hosting an unforgettable wedding reception, a milestone anniversary, a birthday gala, or a corporate dining event, our private banqueting hall offers an opulent setting bathed in regal elegance.

Accommodating up to 200 guests with bespoke table layouts, attentive silver service, and fully personalized multi-course banqueting menus, our events team ensures every detail reflects your unique celebration.

  • ✦

    Bespoke Multi-Course Banqueting Menus

    Curated starters, live street chaat counters, imperial mains, and traditional warm desserts tailored to your palate.

  • ✦

    Outdoor Event Catering Across the UK

    Bringing our full culinary team and signature dishes directly to your chosen venue with seamless execution.

ROYAL MASTERPIECES

A Glimpse into Our Kitchen & Heritage

Royal Gourmet Street Delicacies

Authentic street gastronomic artistry — crisp spiced papdis, velvety curd, fragrant mint chutneys, and pomegranate jewels prepared fresh to order.

Sizzling Clay-Oven Specialties

Charcoal-fired artisanal skewers of marinated cottage cheese, charred bell peppers, and fragrant tandoori spices infused with rich smoky hickory aromas.

Imperial Sweets & Warm Desserts

Traditional royal confections — slow-simmered rose-scented gulab jamuns paired with artisanal pistachio kulfi, saffron rabdi, and delicate gold vark.

Privacy Policy

The Grand Maharaja is committed to protecting and respecting your personal data in accordance with the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR).

01

Who We Are & Scope

The Grand Maharaja (“we”, “our”, or “us”) is an authentic Indian vegetarian restaurant, cocktail bar, and private banqueting venue located at 209 Catherine St, Leicester LE4 6GE, United Kingdom.

We operate as the Data Controller under the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018. This policy outlines how we handle your personal data when you visit our restaurant, book a dining table or banquet, use our website, or contact our team.

02

Information We Collect & How We Use It

We only collect personal information necessary to deliver exceptional dining and hospitality:

  • Contact & Identity: Name, phone number, and email address to confirm and manage table and banquet bookings.
  • Dietary & Special Requests: Dietary preferences (Jain, Swaminarayan, Vegan) and allergen alerts to ensure safe culinary preparation.
  • Secure Payment Tokens: Payment processing for deposits or banquet engagements handled securely via certified PCI-DSS payment gateways. We never store card numbers.
  • Technical Data: Standard IP address, browser type, and anonymous cookies to maintain website performance and user preferences.

We strictly do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data with any third parties.

03

Your Statutory Rights

Under the UK GDPR, you have the right to request access to the personal data we hold about you, request corrections to inaccurate details, request deletion of your information, or object to processing. To exercise any of these rights, please contact our team directly.

DATA PROTECTION & INQUIRIES

For questions about this policy or to manage your data preferences, contact us anytime:
